summary: Implemented directive doctor diagnostics for registry and emitted bundle health. Added a core health classifier, doctor diagnostics for agent_directives.registry and agent_directives.emitted_bundles, advisory-warning handling for directive recovery, and focused coverage for unknown IDs, deprecated emissions, duplicate IDs, invalid data, unsafe dynamic instruction text, stale registry versions, missing required directives, and conflicts.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/agent-directive-health.test.ts tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-compiler.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-runtime-integration.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-regressions.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-goldens.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-snapshot.test.ts; bwrk sync refresh --json; bwrk doctor --strict --json
